# Sted

> Sted is an iPhone app for everything you save. Share a link from any app (a video, a post, a podcast, an article) and Sted reads it for you: it writes a summary and the key ideas, sorts it into topics and projects, and puts together The Recap, a daily digest of what you saved.

## What Sted does

- Save from any app through the iOS share sheet: Instagram, YouTube, X, Safari, Spotify and more.
- Summary and key ideas for every saved link, plus topics.
- Projects to organize saves, and search across the whole library.
- The Recap: every day, Sted's Picks, the topics you saved around and your latest saves.
- Ask Sted (chat, new in version 1.3): ask anything about what you saved, summarize today's saves, recap your week, save links from the chat and revisit past conversations. Answers point to the saves they're based on.

## Plans

- Free: up to 1,000 saves, 50 AI summaries a month, search, limited chat.
- Sted Pro: unlimited saves, 500 AI summaries a month, search, extended chat.
- Founding offer: Sted Pro for $19.99 a year (regular price $79.99 a year) for the first 100 members, at that price for as long as the subscription stays active. Checkout is on the web; Pro unlocks in the iPhone app with the Redeem link from the confirmation email.

## Coming next

- Chrome and Safari extensions: launching soon.
- Web dashboard: launching soon.
- Sted for Android: submitted, in review.
- Screenshots, PDFs, notes and docs: up next, with the same summary, key ideas and topics as links.
